title: E-commerce and logistics
description: Route an order-related message to the queue that owns it, say how urgent the order issue is, and judge whether the customer is asking for something. Vocabulary is deliberately distinct from support (queues, not teams).

instructions.choice: Which queue should handle this order?
instructions.score: How urgent is this order issue?

option_descriptions.catalog: product pages, sizes, stock, sellers, reviews, discount codes, and wishlists
option_descriptions.other: everything else: product questions, store credit, gift cards, promo codes, and loyalty points
option_descriptions.payments: charges, cards, receipts, invoices, wallet credit, and tax on orders
option_descriptions.returns: returns, exchanges, replacements, return labels, and damaged items
option_descriptions.shipping: tracking, delivery dates, couriers, address changes, and lost parcels
